newsitem.title: UK: FORECAST - Reuters foreign exchange poll - May.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Reuters foreign exchange poll - May.

text.p: The dollar is expected to make modest progress against both the mark and yen during the coming months, according to a Reuter survey of 35 banks and financial institutions across the globe.
Following are the full results of Reuters' monthly foreign exchange poll, conducted on May 8 and 9.

The survey showed that sterling is expected to trade at $1.6248 in one month, before weakening to $1.6147 in six months. By this time next year, cable is expected to trade on average at $1.6088.
The lowest level sterling is expected to fall to during the next 12 months is $1.4100, while the highest it is expected to climb to is $1.7200.
The rankings of the 35 forecasters by the accuracy of their one-month forecasts will be published in the first week of June, just before the results of the next poll.
